items.q: Another old friend, Professor Hugh Porter, played that.

ctx.x: Oh, Father, which art in heaven dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear…
Louie's widow, Lucille, Satchmo's companion for 29 years, requested just a closer walk with thee. Another old friend, Professor Hugh Porter, played that. Just a closer walk with thee.

Just a closer walk with thee. Just a closer walk with thee. Granted, Jesus, if you please. Granted, Jesus, if you please. Dear Lord, let it be. Dear Lord, let it be. Dear Lord, let it be. Let it be. Dear Lord, let it be. Dear Lord, let it be. I am weak, but thou art strong. I am weak, but thou art strong. I am weak, but thou art strong. Jesus, keep me from all wrong. Jesus, keep me from all wrong. I'll be satisfied. I am weak, but thou art strong. Lord, as long as I want. Let me walk, let me walk close to thee.…
